text: Chemistry is a fundamental natural science that studies the composition, structure, properties, and change laws of substances. It is known as the "central science" - it connects with basic disciplines such as mathematics, physics, and biology, and also supports the development of application fields such as materials, medicine, energy, and environment. From the interaction of microscopic particles to the transformation of macroscopic substances, from the molecular design in the laboratory to the process optimization in industrial production, the exploration of chemistry runs through the entire process of human's understanding of nature and transformation of the world.
